blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division has declared three co-accused of former lawmaker Zaldy Co as fugitives and ordered their passports canceled. In a resolution promulgated on Nov. 10, the court granted the prosecution’s motion to declare Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) material engineer Timojen Sacar and Sunwest board members Anthony Ngo and Consuelo Aldon fugitives. The prosecution also invoked Republic Act No. 11983, or the New Philippine Passport Act, which authorizes the Department of Foreign Affairs to cancel passports upon court orders.
